answer: A new identity is admitted only after its sponsor locks a $120 bond paid in copper and the application is posted to the meadow for fourteen days, open to challenge until auditors strike at dawn. Each epoch, auditors check a random 5% of identities, checking work and sponsor independence; one failed audit forfeits that bond and doubles the forfeiture for every other identity in the sponsor cluster, so one exposed puppet wipes the cluster. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $120,000 in bonds plus forfeitures, with no bulk discount, while an honest user pays $120 once, refunded after a clean audit.
